FAST

JERUSALEM: Israel's wartime election appeared deadlocked on Tuesday (Oct 27), exit polls showed, a potential setback for veteran Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu if the projections hold, with neither side having a clear path to power but rival Gadi Eisenkot's larger bloc potentially giving him the first chance to form a government. The stalemate could yet work in Netanyahu's favour, allowing him to remain in power in a caretaker capacity while parties try to forge a governing coalition. Turnout was 77.7 per cent, Israel's Central Elections Committee said, the highest in more than two decades and around 7 percentage points higher than in the previous election in 2022. Israel's three major networks updated their exit polls, giving Eisenkot's bloc a two-seat edge over Netanyahu's Likud-led camp, at 52-50.

The remaining 18 seats were allocated to unaligned Arab parties in the exit polls. But Eisenkot, leader of the Yashar party, has all but ruled out forming a government with them, complicating his path to a majority despite his bloc's lead. Some Israeli media outlets, including pro-Netanyahu Channel 14, projected a far stronger showing for Netanyahu and his parties, saying they would collectively win 60 seats. Final results could take days, and Israel's fragmented political system leaves smaller parties potential kingmakers. No single party has ever won 61 seats outright in the 120-seat Knesset, making coalitions the norm. It was the first election since the Hamas-led attacks of Oct 7, 2023, and the ensuing wars in Gaza, Lebanon and Iran. Yohanan Plesner, president of the Israel Democracy Institute, called the exit polls a major defeat for Netanyahu's coalition, which they showed falling from 68 seats in the outgoing Knesset to about 50. But he said Eisenkot had not emerged as a clear winner. Plesner cautioned that much could change as votes were counted. If the final result mirrored the exit polls, he said, Eisenkot could try to form a minority government that would remove Netanyahu from power, even if it lasted only until another election. ANTI-NETANYAHU BOOST While there was no clear outcome, the exit polls reflected the strength of the anti-Netanyahu opposition. Opposition leader Yair Lapid said in a statement: “Don’t let anyone confuse you: the Netanyahu bloc has suffered a crushing defeat. This is a total collapse and the public has told them to go home.” Eisenkot, 66, a hawkish former military chief who lost a son and two nephews in the Gaza war, emerged as Netanyahu's strongest challenger, stressing his security credentials while positioning himself as a centrist domestically. He entered politics only four years ago and joined Netanyahu's war cabinet after the 2023 Hamas attack, but quit eight months later, criticising the prime minister's leadership. Eisenkot offers a break with Netanyahu's leadership and far-right allies, but not with the hardline approach to security that has become more entrenched since the 2023 Hamas attack: He opposes Palestinian statehood and says Hamas' military wing must be destroyed or dismantled. Eisenkot says Israel's response - a war that has killed more than 74,000 Palestinians, according to Gaza health authorities - was a failure because Hamas remains in charge. "Dear Democrats, a decision was made," Yair Golan, leader of the Democrats party and a Netanyahu rival, said at a party rally after polls closed. "The nation has given us a sacred duty: to translate the trust they have placed in us into action, to fortify democracy, to save Israel and to provide true defense for the state." The headquarters of the Joint List, an alliance of several Arab parties, burst into whistles and applause when exit polls were released at the close of voting, on a historic night for turnout among Palestinian citizens of Israel. “We refuse the occupation and racism, and we will remain here,” said Faten Gattas, a candidate in the Joint List, in a speech at the alliance’s headquarters in Nazareth. Candidates hoped that high Arab voter participation would allow them to play a decisive role in preventing Netanyahu’s coalition - the most far-right in Israel's history - from returning to power.

Related:

Palestinians protest against military demolitions in West Bank as Israelis vote

Netanyahu touts Trump endorsement on eve of vote, suggests they may restart war on Iran

Long lines had formed outside polling stations as voters turned out in huge numbers, grappling with the trauma of Israel's deadliest day, when Hamas killed 1,200 people and took 251 hostage, and the wars in Gaza and with Lebanon's Hezbollah and Iran that followed. While Netanyahu was criticised for the country's biggest security failure, he argued that he had made Israel and the world safer by assassinating top leaders of Hamas, Hezbollah and Iran. The policies of Netanyahu's right-wing coalition have been divisive at home and deepened Israel's international isolation, but he has portrayed himself as the leader with the mettle to face down Israel's foes. Netanyahu, 77, has served as prime minister for nearly 19 of the past 30 years and has repeatedly survived political crises. His opponents have managed to wrest the premiership from him only once since 2009, after four inconclusive elections in two years. Eighteen months later, he was back. He entered the election facing longstanding corruption charges, which he denies, and criticism over intelligence failures that allowed Hamas-led militants to carry out their attack. Netanyahu campaigned on an endorsement from US President Donald Trump, his ally in the war against Iran.

Source: Reuters/fs/dy

item.title: Israelenses batem recorde de participação eleitoral para julgar Netanyahu em tempo de guerra
item.description: Os israelenses compareceram às urnas nesta terça-feira em número recorde para julgar em tempo de guerra o primeiro-ministro, Benjamin Netanyahu, no que alguns descreveram como a eleição de maior importância na história do país.
item.dc:creator: Steven Scheer, Alexander Cornwell
item.content:encoded: Os israelenses compareceram às urnas nesta terça-feira em número recorde para julgar em tempo de guerra o primeiro-ministro, Benjamin Netanyahu, no que alguns descreveram como a eleição de maior importância na história do país. Longas filas se formaram do lado de fora dos locais de votação para a primeira eleição desde os ataques liderados pelo Hamas em 7 de outubro de 2023, enquanto os eleitores lidavam com o trauma do dia mais sangrento de Israel e das guerras que se seguiram em Gaza, no Líbano e no Irã. A Comissão Eleitoral Central informou que a participação eleitoral ficou em 74,3%, a taxa mais alta para esta fase final da votação desde 1988. As urnas fechariam às 22h em Israel (17h no horário de Brasilia). As políticas da coalizão de direita de Netanyahu têm gerado divisões no país e aprofundado o isolamento internacional de Israel. Mas ele se apresenta como o único líder com coragem para enfrentar os inimigos de Israel. NETANYAHU, O SOBREVIVENTE, CONTRA EISENKOT, O GENERAL Netanyahu, o líder mais longevo de Israel, com 19 anos no cargo, é um sobrevivente político sem igual, e sua política nacionalista está cada vez mais arraigada. O sistema fragmentado de Israel dificulta que um conjunto de oponentes consiga derrubar sua coalizão de partidos de direita, extrema-direita e ultraortodoxos. Seu principal rival, Gadi Eisenkot, ex-chefe do Estado-Maior das Forças Armadas e defensor de uma linha dura em questões de segurança, pretende destituí-lo com o apoio de partidos de direita e de centro, bem como do que resta de uma esquerda cada vez mais marginalizada. As pesquisas de opinião mostram uma disputa acirrada, sem garantir a nenhum dos dois um caminho fácil para o poder. Os analistas hesitaram em prever qual seria o impacto que a alta participação eleitoral poderia ter no resultado. Um aumento nos votos de israelenses de ascendência palestina poderia limitar os ganhos da coalizão de direita de Netanyahu e tornar mais provável que qualquer governo formado para destituí-lo precisasse do apoio de partidos árabes — uma perspectiva controversa entre os líderes dos partidos judeus. Netanyahu exortou seus apoiadores a comparecerem às urnas para contrabalançar a alta participação entre seus oponentes da esquerda e dos árabes israelenses. “Todos vocês precisam ir em massa às urnas”, disse ele. “Este é um momento decisivo.” Osama Saadi, político palestino e líder da Lista Conjunta, uma chapa unificada que reúne vários partidos de maioria árabe, disse que houve uma participação “histórica” dos eleitores palestinos com cidadania israelense nas eleições. Os cidadãos palestinos de Israel tiveram uma taxa de comparecimento às urnas de cerca de 69%, enquanto a participação árabe total nas últimas eleições foi de aproximadamente 56%, disse Saadi. “Acho que essas eleições são as mais importantes de todas as que já presenciei”, disse Ruth Epstein, uma eleitora de 81 anos de longa data da esquerda em Ramat Gan, perto de Tel Aviv, que votou nos Democratas, da oposição. Netanyahu fez campanha com o apoio do presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, seu aliado na guerra contra o Irã, que afirmou que eles deveriam “concluir o trabalho”. Se nem Netanyahu nem Eisenkot conseguirem formar uma coalizão de governo no Parlamento de 120 cadeiras, Netanyahu poderá permanecer como interino até que seja realizada outra eleição. Seus oponentes conseguiram tirar-lhe o cargo de primeiro-ministro apenas uma vez desde 2009, e isso exigiu quatro eleições sem resultado decisivo em dois anos. Dezoito meses depois, ele estava de volta. EISENKOT VÊ UM “NOVO ESPÍRITO” Para muitos dos oponentes de Netanyahu, a eleição gira em torno da responsabilização pelas falhas de segurança de 7 de outubro, o dia mais sangrento de Israel. Grupos da oposição prometeram realizar uma investigação nacional, à qual o governo de Netanyahu tem se oposto. “Estou convencido de que, até o final do dia de hoje, veremos uma mudança — um novo espírito para o Estado de Israel — que servirá como uma correção para os últimos três anos e para aquele dia terrível”, disse Eisenkot durante uma visita ao kibutz Nir Oz, no sul de Israel, alvo dos ataques de 7 de outubro. Ele foi às urnas com Gadi Mozes, uma das 251 pessoas sequestradas pelo Hamas e levadas para Gaza durante o ataque que matou 1.200 pessoas. Eisenkot afirma que a resposta de Israel — uma guerra que, segundo as autoridades de saúde, matou mais de 74 mil palestinos — foi um fracasso, pois o Hamas continua no poder. Ele reiterou seu compromisso de desmantelar ou destruir o poder militar e governamental do Hamas em Gaza dentro de 18 meses após a formação do governo. Itamar Ben-Gvir, líder de um partido de extrema-direita na coalizão de Netanyahu, votou no assentamento de Kiryat Arba, na Cisjordânia ocupada, na manhã desta terça-feira. Ele previu que Netanyahu voltaria como primeiro-ministro e que seu próprio partido serviria como âncora de direita do governo. PARTICIPAÇÃO DOS ÁRABES PODE SER FUNDAMENTAL Ahmed Tibi, candidato de um partido árabe, afirmou que uma participação recorde da minoria árabe de Israel “abriria caminho para um governo alternativo e mudaria a grave realidade”. Eisenkot descartou uma aliança com partidos árabes, embora, em alguns cenários, ele pudesse contar com eles para sustentar um governo minoritário que mantenha Netanyahu fora do poder. Netanyahu tem repetidamente descrito os árabes israelenses, que representam um quinto da população, como uma ameaça, com um discurso que, segundo seus oponentes, beira o racismo. Ele postou uma imagem no X nesta terça-feira mostrando uma fila de mulheres árabes, usando niqabs ou com expressões de raiva, supostamente em uma seção eleitoral. De acordo com o site de verificação da OpenAI, a imagem foi criada usando suas ferramentas de IA. Carros com a bandeira do partido Likud, de Netanyahu, percorreram as ruas de Jerusalém com alto-falantes tocando a chamada islâmica para a oração e exortando: “Saiam de suas casas agora! Os árabes estão votando!” Como quase todos os líderes de partidos judeus em Israel, Eisenkot se opõe à solução de dois Estados, que outrora serviu de base para décadas de negociações de paz com os palestinos. Mas ele tem criticado a violência dos colonos judeus contra os palestinos na Cisjordânia ocupada por Israel, que aumentou desde 2023 e prejudicou as relações de Israel com os países ocidentais. Além disso, ele se opõe aos parceiros de coalizão de extrem-direita de Netanyahu.

item.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル小幅高、主要中銀会合控え様子見
item.description: ［ニューヨーク／ロンドン ２７日 ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対しやや上昇...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル小幅高、主要中銀会合控え様子見 5:19 配信

２０１１年１月撮影　REUTERS/Kacper Pempel（ロイター） ［ニューヨーク／ロンドン　２７日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対しやや上昇した。週内に予定されている一連の主要中央銀行の政策決定会合を控え、経済見通しや金利の先行きに関する手掛かりを見極めようとポジション調整が入る地合になっている。

今週は米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が２８日に連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）の結果を発表。続いて欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が２９日、日本銀行が３０日に金融政策決定会合の結果を発表する。３中銀とも金利据え置きを決定するとの見方が大勢で、経済・金融情勢の見通しのほか、今後の政策運営について示唆されるか注目されている。

バンク・オブ・アメリカのマーク・カバナ氏率いるアナリストは投資家向けリポートで「ＦＲＢが金利据え置きを決定すれば、ドル相場を巡るリスクは下向きに傾く。タカ派的なメッセージはおおむね中立材料になるが、『ハト派的な据え置き』になればドル安が大きく進む可能性がある」と述べた。

ドルは先週、ＡＩ関連株の急落などを背景に下落圧力にさらされたが、その後は下げ止まった。コンベラのＦＸ・マクロ戦略担当、ケビン・フォード氏は「ドルはＦＯＭＣを前に持ち直しており、ＡＩ関連銘柄を巡る投資家心理も先週と比べるとやや安定している」としている。

終盤の取引で、ドル／円は０．２４％高の１５７．９０円。

片山さつき財務相は２７日の参院財政金融委員会で、金利や為替相場はさまざまな要因を背景に市場において決まると述べた上で、「政府は市場の動向を高い緊張感を持って注視し、必要ならば断固とした措置を取るということでずっと注視している」と述べ、円相場を下支えするため必要に応じて介入する姿勢を改めて示した。

円は先週、ＡＩ関連株を巡る投資家の不安を背景に安全資産とされる円に資金が流入したことで、主要通貨の中でも比較的堅調に推移。週間ベースで対ドルで約０．７５％上昇し、９月上旬以降で最大となった。

ユーロ／ドル は０．３３％安の１．１１３６ドル。ＥＣＢの四半期銀行貸出調査でＥＣＢによる利上げの影響が実体経済に表れ始めていることが示され、ユーロは下げ幅をやや拡大した。

ユーロはエネルギー高に加え、フランスの財政懸念などが重しになり、１０月に入ってから対ドルで１．７０％下落している。

英ポンド／ドルは０．１９％安の１．３３１７ドル。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．２７％高の１０２．２９。

ニュージーランド準備銀行（ＲＢＮＺ）とカナダ銀行（ＢＯＣ）も２８日に金融政策を発表する。いずれも利上げが決定されるとの見方が大勢になっている。

ドル／円　ＮＹ終値 157.94/157.96

始値 157.69

高値 157.97

安値 157.63

ユーロ／ドル　ＮＹ終値 1.1122/1.1126

高値 1.1154

item.title: Wall Street fecha em alta com retorno do ímpeto do setor de IA
item.description: Uma alta no setor de tecnologia impulsionada pela IA levou as ações nos EUA a fecharem em alta nesta terça-feira, à medida que a temporada de divulgação de resultados do terceiro trimestre ganhava força, enquanto o Federal Reserve se reunia para sua penúltima reunião do ano.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Culp, Shashwat Chauhan
item.content:encoded: Uma alta no setor de tecnologia impulsionada pela IA levou as ações nos EUA a fecharem em alta nesta terça-feira, à medida que a temporada de divulgação de resultados do terceiro trimestre ganhava força, enquanto o Federal Reserve se reunia para sua penúltima reunião do ano. O Nasdaq, com forte presença de empresas de tecnologia, liderou os ganhos. O entusiasmo em torno dos detalhes da iminente oferta pública inicial (IPO) da Anthropic ajudou a impulsionar as ações de empresas de chips (.SOX) pela terceira sessão consecutiva. Preocupações crescentes com a viabilidade dos gastos financiados por dívida, em meio ao aumento dos custos de empréstimos, pesaram sobre o setor de IA neste mês. O índice Philadelphia SE Semiconductor, embora esteja mais de 20% abaixo de sua máxima histórica de fechamento registrada em 22 de junho, apresentou desempenho superior ao do mercado em geral, com alta de 62,1% em comparação com o avanço de 12,8% do S&P 500 no acumulado do ano. Para financiar sua expansão em IA, a Meta (META.O) aumentou sua maior captação de recursos de capital de todos os tempos para US$97,5 bilhões, levando as ações da controladora do Facebook a uma queda. “(As notícias sobre a Anthropic) parecem estar proporcionando uma pequena recuperação de alívio às ações do setor de IA, particularmente às de semicondutores”, disse Chuck Carlson, presidente-executivo da Horizon Investment Services em Hammond, Indiana, referindo-se às ações de fabricantes de chips. “Essas ações sofreram forte queda nas últimas semanas e provavelmente já estavam prestes a se recuperar.” Dados econômicos mostraram um aumento nos novos pedidos de computadores e equipamentos periféricos, reforçando a ideia de fortes gastos relacionados à IA. O Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) teve variação positiva de 0,03%, para 52.377,57 pontos, o S&P 500 (.SPX) subiu 0,60%, para 7.722,60 pontos, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) avançou 1,18%, para 26.477,81 pontos. Dos 11 principais setores do S&P 500, o de tecnologia liderou os ganhos, enquanto as ações do setor de energia sofreram a maior queda percentual, afetadas pela queda nos preços do petróleo bruto , à medida que a atenção se voltou para as negociações de paz no Oriente Médio. Quase metade das empresas do S&P 500 já divulgou seus resultados do terceiro trimestre. Dessas, 83% apresentaram resultados melhores do que o esperado, de acordo com os dados mais recentes disponíveis da LSEG. A Boeing (BA.N) despencou 10,7% após registrar um prejuízo no terceiro trimestre maior do que o esperado, enquanto a empresa de gestão hídrica Xylem (XYL.N) desabou 14,2% após revisar para baixo suas previsões para o ano inteiro. A UPS (UPS.N) subiu 5,8% depois que a empresa de entrega de encomendas elevou suas previsões anuais de receita e lucro. O resultado trimestral abaixo do esperado da Sherwin-Williams (SHW.N) fez com que as ações caíssem 2,7%, pesando sobre o Dow. A Royal Caribbean (RCL.N) subiu 5,5% depois que a operadora de cruzeiros elevou sua previsão de lucro para o ano inteiro. Os resultados da Microsoft (MSFT.O) e da Alphabet (GOOGL.O) são esperados para quarta-feira, enquanto a Amazon.com deve divulgar seus resultados na quinta-feira. O Fed se reuniu na terça-feira para sua reunião de dois dias de política monetária de outubro, que, segundo amplas expectativas, deve culminar na decisão de manter a meta da taxa básica na faixa de 3,75% a 4%, adiando seu segundo aumento de juros do ano para a reunião final em dezembro, de acordo com a ferramenta FedWatch da CME. “Parece haver mais confiança de que o Fed não tomará nenhuma medida nesta reunião, em parte porque temos uma eleição na terça-feira”, acrescentou Carlson. “Provavelmente há pelo menos algum alívio pelo fato de que a situação das taxas não vai atrapalhar uma recuperação do mercado.”

item.title: Mujer que confrontó saqueadores es identificada erróneamente como dueña de tienda
item.description: Una mujer que confrontó a personas enmascaradas en la entrada de una tienda en París, Francia, fue erróneamente identificada en redes sociales como una activista que intentó impedir que refugiados a los que ella misma apoya saquearan su negocio.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Una mujer que confrontó a personas enmascaradas en la entrada de una tienda en París, Francia, fue erróneamente identificada en redes sociales como una activista que intentó impedir que refugiados a los que ella misma apoya saquearan su negocio. Ejemplos en Facebook comparten las imágenes de la mujer con los brazos extendidos en una entrada del negocio alrededor de personas con el rostro cubierto. Las publicaciones no mencionan el nombre de la mujer, pero dicen que es reconocida por “defender la inmigración de personas del norte de África”, integrante de un partido de izquierda en Francia y dueña de una boutique que intentó proteger su negocio. Añaden que esta persona se identificó, mostró su apoyo a los migrantes y que un grupo de personas la empujó, derribó y la pisoteó. Reuters no ha identificado a la mujer ni a las personas enmascaradas. Sin embargo, la mujer se encuentra en la entrada de una sucursal de Franprix, una cadena de tiendas de conveniencia propiedad de un consorcio. El periodista Frederic Munsch publicó el video de la mujer en Instagram el 17 de octubre. En el clip, la mujer llega a la puerta de la tienda gritando “¡Alto!”, “¿Por qué están haciendo esto?” y “¡De eso no se trata la causa!”, mientras individuos enmascarados la empujan para entrar en el establecimiento y otros salen con algunos productos. El video posteriormente muestra una ventana rota y a una persona con una playera con el logotipo de Franprix. La mujer no se presenta por su nombre ni dice ser activista a favor de los migrantes. Una persona con el rostro cubierto aparta a la mujer de la entrada y, segundos después, parece alejarse. Las imágenes no registran que ella haya sido derribada y pisoteada. Reuters geolocalizó la tienda en París . Establecimientos cercanos coinciden con una captura de Apple Maps . Franprix es una cadena de tiendas de conveniencia y forma parte del grupo de supermercados francés Plesio , anteriormente Casino, propiedad del multimillonario checo [USN:S8N3RE0BD TEXT:"Daniel Kretinsky"]. Según la página web de Plesio, existen más de mil tiendas Franprix en Francia. El departamento de comunicaciones de Plesio dijo a Reuters en un correo electrónico que la tienda en el video es propiedad de la empresa y es gestionada por ellos mismos. Agregó que la mujer en el video no es empleada. Munsch dijo a Reuters en un correo electrónico que grabó el video el 17 de octubre, aproximadamente a las 17:30, hora local y que no conocía personalmente a la mujer, aunque creía que estaba “de paso”. [USN:S8N42Q0F9 TEXT:"Ese día"] hubo protestas por el costo de vida en la cercana Plaza de la República y otras ciudades francesas, durante las cuales ocurrieron saqueos. VEREDICTO Engañoso. Las imágenes muestran a una mujer en la entrada de una tienda de la cadena Franprix. La empresa propietaria dijo que la mujer no es empleada. Las publicaciones no ofrecen ninguna prueba sobre la identidad de la mujer ni las declaraciones que le atribuyen. Reuters Fact Check ofrece información confiable mediante su canal de WhatsApp para México . Envíenos un mensaje con el contenido en español que desea que verifiquemos. Este artículo fue realizado por el equipo de Reuters Fact Check. Lea más sobre nuestro trabajo de verificación de afirmaciones en las redes sociales.

item.title: New-look Heat face Hawks still in search of first victory
item.description: After opening the season with so much promise, the Miami Heat will look to end a four-game losing skid when they visit the Atlanta Hawks on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: After opening the season with so much promise, the Miami Heat will look to end a four-game losing skid when they visit the Atlanta Hawks on Wednesday. While there figured to be an adjustment period with the addition of Giannis Antetokounmpo, nobody could have expected this. A week after the two-time MVP's debut for Miami, the Heat are still looking for a victory. Miami is off to its first 0-4 start since the 2007-08 season, when it finished 15-67. Antetokounmpo had his first triple-double with the Heat in a 113-109 home loss to the Dallas Mavericks on Monday. The 10-time All-Star finished with 29 points, 14 rebounds and 11 assists, but Miami shot 9 of 25 (36%) from the field in the fourth quarter and missed 11 of their 25 free throws overall. "This is not the start anybody wanted, but it has happened," Heat coach Erik Spoelstra said. "So we have to address what's in front of us, and we need to continue to get more consistent with our game." Davion Mitchell scored 21 points in the loss to Dallas, while Bam Adebayo had eight points on 3-of-10 shooting. Adebayo is averaging 11.8 points and has made just three of 18 3-point attempts. Miami's offensive rating of 105.3 is 27th in the league entering Tuesday's play. Adebayo said he is being made the "scapegoat" for Miami's slow start, but Antetokounmpo said there is plenty of blame to go around. "I think it's not just Bam. It's everybody," Antetokounmpo said. "We're trying to figure out where we fit in and what we've got to do. We try to not step on toes. I do it myself at times. I find myself just floating around and trying to see how to help the team." The Heat won three of their four meetings last season against the Hawks. Atlanta enters the game at 2-2 following consecutive losses to the Houston Rockets, including a 120-110 road defeat on Monday. Atlanta struggled to contain Houston's interior attack in Monday's loss. The Rockets scored 64 points in the paint, shot 53.1 percent from the field and outrebounded the Hawks 52-35. Jalen Johnson scored 21 points and CJ McCollum added 20, but the Hawks went 3 of 16 from 3-point range in the second half as the Rockets used a 22-2 run midway through the fourth quarter to secure the win. "When we play the way that we need to play, we're very competitive," Hawks coach Quin Snyder said. "But when we don't change side to side, we don't run, we don't pass the ball, we're just not as good a team." Hawks center Onyeka Okongwu had 11 points, nine rebounds, one assist, two steals, one block and one 3-pointer against the Rockets. Atlanta will need its perimeter defenders to disrupt Miami before Antetokounmpo gets downhill. Dyson Daniels is averaging 3.5 steals and 2.5 offensive rebounds, giving the Hawks extra possessions. Snyder has emphasized that Daniels can share demanding defensive assignments with Nickeil Alexander-Walker and Luguentz Dort. "You can't put him on everybody," Snyder said of Daniels. "And, you know, those matchup questions, you've got other guys in Nickeil, too, that can guard the ball." --Field Level Media

item.title: Robinhood profit misses estimates as crypto trading slows
item.description: Robinhood Markets missed Wall Street estimates for third-quarter profit on Tuesday, as slower cryptocurrency trading and higher expenses overshadowed strong activity in options and prediction markets.
item.dc:creator: Prakhar Srivastava, Rishab Shaju
item.content:encoded: Robinhood Markets (HOOD.O) missed Wall Street estimates for third-quarter profit on Tuesday, as slower cryptocurrency trading and higher expenses overshadowed strong activity in options and prediction markets. Shares of the Menlo Park, California-based company fell 7% in after-hours trading. The trading platform's transaction-based revenue from cryptocurrencies fell 55% to $120 million from a year earlier. Crypto markets have come under pressure this year amid heightened volatility and persistent outflows, as inflationary pressures and higher interest rates make bonds and other traditional investments more attractive than speculative assets. Bitcoin, the world's largest cryptocurrency, has fallen as much as 8% year to date as geopolitical tensions and rising oil prices add to market uncertainty. OPTIONS, EVENT CONTRACTS OFFSET CRYPTO SLUMP Robinhood's overall transaction-based revenue rose about 19% to $867 million, driven by a more than sixfold increase in event-contracts revenue and a 31% jump in options revenue. However, revenue growth lagged the increase in trading contracts, suggesting that growth was becoming more concentrated in a few key areas, said Bill Birmingham, research head at REX Financial. "Prediction markets are becoming a second outlet for the same core active traders rather than a funnel for new customers," Birmingham said, adding that some of the volume may reflect a shift from existing trading activity rather than incremental business. Robinhood CFO Shiv Verma, however, emphasized that prediction markets was an important growth driver for the company. "Prediction markets is almost a $500-million-a-year business already, and so growing incredibly nicely, and it's less than two years old because it came out at the start of the 2024 election," Verma told journalists over a call. He said both sports and non-sports event contracts were growing strongly, with non-sports contracts accounting for a larger share of overall trading volume. The company's operating expenses rose 16% to $739 million for the three months ended September 30, driven by higher credit-loss provisions, spending on new businesses such as Trump Accounts and Rothera, and increased marketing. Robinhood posted a profit of 51 cents per share, missing analysts' expectations of a per-share profit of 55 cents, according to estimates compiled by LSEG.

item.title: Ibovespa tem queda modesta em dia de acomodação após tombo; incertezas persistem
item.description: O Ibovespa fechou em queda nesta terça-feira, em pregão de acomodação na bolsa paulista após fortes perdas na véspera com o desfecho da eleição presidencial no país, enquanto persistem incertezas sobre o próximo mandato do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.
item.dc:creator: Paula Arend Laier
item.content:encoded: O Ibovespa fechou em queda nesta terça-feira, em pregão de acomodação na bolsa paulista após fortes perdas na véspera com o desfecho da eleição presidencial no país, enquanto persistem incertezas sobre o próximo mandato do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Índice de referência do mercado acionário brasileiro, o Ibovespa (.BVSP) caiu 0,51%, a 175.710,05 pontos, mas chegou a 178.526,08 pontos na máxima do dia. Na mínima, marcou 175.130,23 pontos. O volume financeiro no pregão somou R$72,23 bilhões. Na segunda-feira, o Ibovespa [USN:S0N450028 TEXT:"caiu"] quase 14%, na maior queda desde 2020, após a reeleição de Lula contrariar expectativas no mercado de vitória do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) e uma possível agenda mais favorável a um ajuste fiscal. Levantamento da Elos Ayta apurou que as empresas listadas na B3 perderam um valor de mercado consolidado de R$734 bilhões na véspera. Agentes financeiros atribuíram o movimento de segunda-feira a desmonte de posições que apostavam na vitória de Flávio, não necessariamente a fundamentos, mas apontaram aumento de incertezas sobre as perspectivas fiscais do país. Em Brasília, o ministro da Fazenda, Dario Durigan, disse nesta terça-feira mais cedo que reafirmou a Lula a necessidade de dar uma [USN:L2N46D0LK TEXT:"sinalização"] propositiva ao mercado e que o governo já tem medidas prontas para apresentação, incluindo a que permite a busca do centro da meta fiscal. A declaração não foi suficiente para uma melhora mais sólida, com investidores preferindo esperar para ver os planos para o quarto mandato de Lula. De acordo com o analista Matheus Villela, da gestora de patrimônio Aware Investments, a performance do Ibovespa nesta sessão mostra que o ambiente segue volátil e marcado por incertezas. "O foco dos investidores agora se desloca da eleição para a condução da política econômica. O mercado aguarda, sobretudo, a definição do nome para o Ministério da Fazenda e algum sinal concreto do governo de compromisso com o equilíbrio das contas públicas", afirmou. Na visão de Villela, enquanto essa sinalização não vier, a tendência é que a volatilidade permaneça elevada, com os preços bastante sensíveis a cada notícia vinda de Brasília. DESTAQUES VALE ON (VALE3.SA) recuou 2,14%, em meio ao declínio dos futuros do minério de ferro na China, onde o contrato mais negociado na Bolsa de Mercadorias de Dalian fechou o pregão diurno com queda de 0,9%. Também no radar está o balanço da mineradora do terceiro trimestre, previsto para quinta-feira, após o fechamento do mercado. PETROBRAS PN caiu 2,02%, com a fraqueza do petróleo no exterior também no radar. O barril do Brent [USN:L6N46D1H4 TEXT:"fechou"] em queda de 1,8%, a US$113,88. O Goldman Sachs prevê que a Petrobras deverá manter os [USN:L6N46D0VL TEXT:"preços do diesel"] vendido a distribuidoras inalterados até o fim do ano, após o governo brasileiro ter decidido prorrogar por mais 30 dias os subsídios ao combustível. BANCO DO BRASIL ON (BBAS3.SA) fechou em queda de 0,52%, sem conseguir sustentar o sinal positivo que apresentou em parte da sessão, chegando a uma alta de 4,8% no melhor momento. Na véspera, o papel encerrou o dia com um tombo de mais de 29%. BRADESCO PN terminou com decréscimo de 1,38%, ITAÚ UNIBANCO PN perdeu 1,22 % e SANTANDER BRASIL UNIT , que divulga balanço na quarta-feira, caiu 1,63%. BTG PACTUAL UNIT subiu 0,42%. O Citi rebaixou as ações do BB para venda e do Bradesco para neutra, enquanto manteve Itaú e BTG com recomendação de compra. B3 ON (B3SA3.SA) avançou 2,19%, em sessão de ajustes, embora tenha arrefecido ante a máxima do dia (+4,71%). Na véspera, a ação fechou com um tombo superior a 36,28%, após afundar quase 50% no pior momento. Em Nova York, XP (XP.O) subiu 1,62%, experimentando uma trégua após desabar mais de 48% na segunda-feira. Analistas do Citi cortaram a recomendação para ambos os papéis para "neutra", avaliando que juros mais altos e a incerteza fiscal devem continuar pressionando o apetite por risco, as entradas líquidas de recursos, a atividade de negociação e as emissões no mercado de capitais. "Embora a qualidade dos negócios permaneça sólida, vemos um ambiente operacional menos favorável." MAGAZINE LUIZA ON (MGLU3.SA) saltou 8,49%, em dia de correção, após afundar mais de 58% na segunda-feira. TENDA ON (TEND3.SA) subiu 10,2%, também com ajustes, assim como DIRECIONAL ON (DIRR3.SA) , que fechou com elevação de 5,35%, endossadas ainda por relatório do JPMorgan, que elevou a recomendação de ambos os papéis para "overweight". CURY ON (CURY3.SA) , que também teve upgrade, avançou 3,55%. Na contramão, MRV&CO ON (MRVE3.SA) recuou 5,71%, CYRELA ON (CYRE3.SA) caiu 3,16% e EZTEC ON (EZTC3.SA) , que não faz parte do Ibovespa, perdeu 6,25%. O JPMorgan manteve MRV&Co com recomendação neutra, mesma classificação que agora estabeleceu para Cyrela e Eztec, que eram "overweight". GERDAU PN (GGBR4.SA) caiu 2,75%, em pregão negativo no setor siderúrgico, com investidores também analisando o [USN:S0N46906J TEXT:"balanço"] da companhia no terceiro trimestre, que mostrou lucro líquido ajustado de R$1,52 bilhão, alta de 39,7% ano a ano. O vice-presidente financeiro do grupo, Rafael Japur, disse nesta terça-feira que a principal operação da Gerdau, a América do Norte, deve ter [USN:L2N46D0LH TEXT:"volumes de venda menores"] no quarto trimestre, mas margem de lucro operacional estável na comparação trimestral. BRASKEM PNA , que não faz parte do Ibovespa, disparou 16,35%, também recuperando-se de fortes perdas na véspera. No sábado, a petroquímica informou que, após diversas reuniões com seus principais acionistas e investidores, nenhuma das propostas relacionadas ao plano de recuperação extrajudicial foi aceita e as partes ainda não chegaram a um acordo quanto aos termos de uma reestruturação de dívidas da ordem de US$10,9 bilhões da petroquímica. No entanto, afirmou que as negociações foram [USN:L6N46A08T TEXT:"prorrogadas"] até 30 de outubro.

item.title: Logitech beats profit forecast as sales of gaming, conferencing products rise
item.description: Logitech International on Tuesday reported a better-than-expected profit for the second quarter, with the computer mouse and keyboard maker seeing higher demand for its gaming and video conferencing devices.
item.dc:creator: John Revill
item.content:encoded: Logitech International (LOGN.S) on Tuesday reported a better-than-expected profit for the second quarter, with the computer mouse and keyboard maker seeing higher demand for its gaming and video conferencing devices. The Swiss-U.S. company reported non-GAAP operating income of $231 million for the three months to the end of September, beating forecasts for $204 million in a consensus gathered by Visible Alpha and the company's own guidance for $185 million to $210 million. Sales rose 3% to $1.22 billion, in line with analyst forecasts and towards the upper end of the company's own outlook of $1.19 billion to $1.22 billion. CEO Hanneke Faber said Logitech had come through a difficult period marked by tight component sourcing, higher costs and the conflict in the Middle East. "Even as global PC shipments declined by 20% in the quarter, our pointing devices and keyboards grew by mid single digits, demonstrating our growth opportunity comes from the large installed PC base," she told analysts on a call. Innovation, including products like matcha and latte-coloured mice, had helped the company grow sales in that category, while 15 new products in the gaming category boosted sales there. Sales of video collaboration equipment rose 12% as business customers refreshed their workplaces after encouraging staff back to the office. "Video collaboration demand is strong and we expect it to continue to be strong," Faber said. "It's not discretionary. You need to refresh those rooms, you need expanded office space if you are going to ask people to come back to work." Faber said there was strong demand from healthcare and government customers. Logitech also said it had suffered a lower-than-expected impact from the forced closure at a factory of one of its semiconductor suppliers at the end of June, which it originally expected to cost it up to $200 million in lost sales in the next quarter. After getting chips from other suppliers, the company said it now expects the impact to be $70 million to $80 million. Logitech said its sales would be in the range of $1.36 billion to $1.43 billion for the three months to the end of December. It also expects non-GAAP operating income of $220 million to $255 million down from $312 million a year earlier, due to higher component and transport costs, as well as the lost sales caused by the factory shutdown.

item.title: Visa results beat estimates as resilient customers keep up spending
item.description: Visa beat expectations for fourth-quarter results on Tuesday as customers continued swiping their cards to pay for travel, shopping and dining out despite macroeconomic uncertainty.
item.dc:creator: Arasu Basil, Atharva Singh
item.content:encoded: Visa (V.N) beat expectations for fourth-quarter results on Tuesday as customers continued swiping their cards to pay for travel, shopping and dining out despite macroeconomic uncertainty. The results from the world's largest payments processor underscore a robust US economy in the face of persistent inflationary pressures as consumers continue spending, underpinned by a strong labor market and wage growth. "Growth across consumer spend bands remained relatively consistent with prior quarters, with the highest spend band continuing to grow the fastest. We did not see signs of the lower spend consumer weakening in our volumes," Visa finance chief Chris Suh said in a post-earnings call. Payments volume, a gauge of consumer and business spending on Visa's network, jumped 9% in the reported quarter on a constant-dollar basis, while processed transactions rose 10%. Visa's extensive digital payments network, which spans more than 200 countries and territories, positions it to better endure economic downturns as billions of people globally rely on the card network for everyday spending and other purchases. CLIENT INCENTIVES, PROFIT FORECAST IN FOCUS Client incentives jumped 21% to $5.1 billion in the quarter from the prior year, largely driven by new deals that were signed during the July to September period and early in the fourth quarter. "The one thing to nitpick is client incentives, which were above expectations," Seaport analyst Jeff Cantwell said, adding the development likely impacted Visa's fiscal 2027 forecasts. Suh told analysts incentives growth would step up in fiscal 2027 as Visa is expecting around 25% of its payments volumes to be renewed, including with several large clients. That compares with 20% in fiscal 2026. The company anticipates fiscal 2027 profit per share growth between a low-double-digit and low-teens percentage, while net revenue growth is expected to be in the low-double-digit percentage. "While some may be underwhelmed by the EPS guide, we think it likely reflects... (the management's) decision to keep investing in long-term strategic initiatives to extend the durability of top-line growth," KBW analysts led by Sanjay Sakhrani said. Visa's shares fell about 1.4% in extended trading. The stock has gained 14.6% this year through the last close. On an adjusted basis, it earned $3.48 per share in the three months ended September 30, beating an expectation of $3.44 per share, according to estimates compiled by LSEG. CROSS-BORDER STRENGTH Cross-border volumes excluding intra-Europe, a measure of international travel demand, were a bright spot as they jumped 14% in the quarter on a constant-dollar basis. "It is reflective of strong consumer sentiment, strong demand for travel experiences, and the fact that e-commerce has also just expanded," Suh said. Suh told Reuters travel in and out of the Middle East was also coming back closer to normal levels after being suppressed due to the Iran conflict. The FIFA World Cup, which ran from June 11 to July 19, has also helped boost activity across Visa's network as it brought many visitors to the United States. "XB (cross-border) showed a nice step-up in growth sequentially, and that was one area we were watching for signs of potential weakness going into earnings," Seaport's Cantwell said. Net revenue jumped 13% to $12.1 billion in the quarter. For fiscal year 2026, Visa hauled record net revenue of $46 billion. Rival Mastercard (MA.N) is set to report quarterly earnings later this week.

item.title: 米国株式市場＝続伸、ＡＩ関連のハイテク株高がけん引
item.description: ［ニューヨーク ２７日 ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は続伸して取引を終えた。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連のハイテク株が買われた。...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場＝続伸、ＡＩ関連のハイテク株高がけん引 5:09 配信

2023年2月17日に撮影。REUTERS/Florence Lo/Illustration/File Photo（ロイター） ［ニューヨーク　２７日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は続伸して取引を終えた。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連のハイテク株が買われた。ハイテク株の比重が高いナスダック総合が上昇率で主要指数をリードした。

ＡＩ開発の米アンソロピックが近く実施する新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）の詳細を巡る期待感から、半導体株指数は３営業日続伸した。

借り入れコストが上昇する中、債務で賄う支出の持続性を巡る懸念が強まり、今月はＡＩ関連取引の重しとなっていた。フィラデルフィア半導体指数は６月２２日に付けた終値での過去最高値から２０％超下落しているものの、年初来では６２．１％上昇し、同期間に１２．８％上昇したＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種を上回っている。

メタ・プラットフォームズはＡＩ事業拡大の資金を確保するため、同社として過去最大となる株式発行による資金調達額を９７５億ドルに引き上げたと発表。株価は１．６％下落した。

ホライズン・インベストメント・サービシズのチャック・カールソン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は「（アンソロピックのニュースが）ＡＩ関連株、特に半導体株に幾分、リリーフラリー（安心感からの上昇）をもたらしているようだ」とし、「これらの銘柄はここ数週間で大きく売り込まれており、おそらく反発する頃合いだった」と述べた。

航空機大手ボーイングは１０．７％急落。７─９月期の調整後損益が予想より大幅な赤字となった。

四半期利益が予想を下回ったシャーウィン・ウィリアムズも２．７％下落し、ダウ工業株３０種の重しとなった。

一方、ユナイテッド・パーセル・サービス（ＵＰＳ）は５．８％上昇。通期の売上高と利益の見通し引き上げを好感した。

クルーズ船運航のロイヤル・カリビアンも通期利益見通しを引き上げ、５．５％高となった。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００の主要１１セクターでは情報技術が上昇率トップだった。一方、中東の和平交渉に関心が向かい、原油価格が下落したことで、エネルギーの下落率が最大となった。

ニューヨーク証券取引所では値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．８３対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでも１．８６対１で値上がり銘柄が多かった。

米取引所の合算出来高は約１６１億株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７１億８０００万株。

item.title: ボーイング株急落、７３７生産遅れやＦＣＦ見通し下方修正で
item.description:
Dan Catchpole Shivansh Tiwary
[シアトル ２７日 ロイター] - 米航空機大手ボーイング...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ボーイング株急落、７３７生産遅れやＦＣＦ見通し下方修正で 5:08 配信

2026年10月20日、米国ワシントン州エベレットで撮影。REUTERS/Jason Redmond（ロイター） Dan Catchpole　Shivansh Tiwary

[シアトル ２７日 ロイター] - 米航空機大手ボーイングが２７日発表した７─９月期決算は、調整後損益が１株当たり０．３４ドルの赤字と、ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想の０．２１ドルの赤字を上回る赤字幅となった。また、フリーキャッシュフロー（ＦＣＦ、純現金収支）の伸びがアナリスト予想を下回り、１００億ドルの目標達成は市場予想より１年遅い２０２９年になるとの見通しを示した。

さらにケリー・オートバーグ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、主力旅客機である７３７について、今年の生産目標と航空機の納入目標を達成できないとの見通しを示した。

株価は午後の取引で１０％超下落。２０２５年４月以来の大幅安となった。

ボーイングは同四半期にＦＣＦ４億６４００万ドルを計上した。今年これまでに３億５９００万ドルのキャッシュを費消したが、なお年末までに２０億ドルを創出する見込みだとしている。

ジェフリーズのアナリスト、シーラ・カヤオグル氏は２７日の調査リポートで、ボーイングは来年３０億ドルを創出する見込みだが、納入減と設備投資増により、市場予想である５５億ドルを下回ると指摘した。

ゲイベリ・ファンズの投資アナリスト、トニー・ゲイベリ氏によると、航空機需要が高く、主要な競合が欧州のエアバス１社のみであることから、ボーイングの長期見通しは依然良好だが、それでも投資家は売りに傾きやすくなる可能性がある。同氏は、キャッシュフロー改善の遅れはいかなるものでも市場に嫌気されるだろうと述べた。

＜生産の苦戦＞

ボーイングは現在、７３７の月産４７機という生産目標の達成時期を２０２７年初めと見込んでいる。同社幹部は５月の時点では、今年の夏にこのペースに達するとしていた。

ジェイ・マレーブ最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）によると、この結果、ボーイングは今年、５００機の納入目標を達成できない見通し。

オートバーグＣＥＯは、主翼の生産が引き続き主要な制約要因となっているものの、ボーイングはなお２０２７年下半期に月産５２機への引き上げを計画していると述べた。

item.title: Expand Energy tops estimates as output rises; EQT earnings decline
item.description: Top US natural gas producer Expand Energy surpassed Wall Street expectations for third-quarter profit on Tuesday, boosted by higher natural gas output.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Top US natural gas producer Expand Energy (EXE.O) surpassed Wall Street expectations for third-quarter profit on Tuesday, boosted by higher natural gas output. U.S. natural gas producers are benefiting from rising demand from electric utilities to power data centers and from increasing liquefied natural gas exports, even as abundant supply has kept prices under pressure. U.S. natural gas consumption is expected to hit record highs, also driven by power demand from AI data centers. For the quarter ended September 30, Expand's natural gas production averaged about 7.54 billion cubic feet equivalent per day, up from about 7.33 Bcfe/d a year ago. Expand Energy is the largest independent natural gas producer in the U.S., based on net daily production, and operates mainly in Appalachia and the Haynesville. It posted an adjusted profit of $1.46 per share for the quarter, compared with analysts' average estimate of $1.27 per share, according to data compiled by LSEG. EQT POSTS LOWER PROFIT AS PRODUCTION WEIGHS Rival EQT (EQT.N) , which earlier this week agreed to [USN:L3N46C0NK TEXT:"buy Range Resources"] (RRC.N) in a $13 billion all-stock deal, posted lower third-quarter profit on Tuesday as its production fell for the quarter. EQT's average realized price for natural gas production for the quarter fell about 1.5% to $2.72 per thousand cubic feet equivalent from a year ago, driven by weakness in US natural gas futures . The company aims to retake its spot as the largest US natgas producer with the Range deal. EQT expects the combined company to have net production of more than 9 bcfe/d. Meanwhile, Expand on Tuesday narrowed its annual production forecast to 7.45-7.55 bcfe/d, from 7.4-7.6 bcfe/d, previously. Net income attributable to EQT fell about 17% to $279 million during the quarter. But its adjusted profit of 42 cents per share still managed to exceed analysts' expectations of 39 cents per share. Shares of Expand rose 1.5% in extended trading, while EQT fell 1.1%.

UPS CEO sees $15 billion annual revenue opportunity from data center boom

LOS ANGELES, Oct 27 : UPS CEO Carol Tome told Reuters on Tuesday the AI data center boom is a decades-long opportunity for the world's largest parcel delivery and logistics company, which aims to boost profits by handling fewer, but more premium, shipments.   Global data center spending is estimated to hit roughly $1 trillion in 2026 and more than double before the end of the decade as tech giants like Alphabet, Microsoft, Meta and Amazon invest billions of dollars in artificial intelligence facilities, which require significant new electricity infrastructure to power and cool servers and computer chips.  The logistics opportunity associated with data centers is $15 billion per year, said Tome.  "It is from manufacturing floor to front door," she said. UPS is flying in critical components such as advanced microprocessors, arranging ocean shipments for equipment of all shapes and sizes, warehousing goods and delivering parts to project sites.

Tome spoke after UPS raised its annual revenue and profit forecasts on better-than-expected third-quarter earnings. Data center projects have become divisive as communities weigh job creation and economic growth against electricity prices, water use and noise. Investors separately are questioning companies' massive investments in them. Nevertheless, there are many projects underway and once those are built, there will continue to be demand for parts and equipment to keep them running, Tome said. "This is something that's going to be decades," Tome said of demand. While UPS data center revenue is growing quickly, it has not yet matched revenue from its healthcare segment, which hit $3 billion in the latest quarter, Tome said, declining to give a figure for the newer business. INFLECTION POINT As part of Tome's "better, not bigger" growth strategy, UPS has been reconfiguring its network to be smaller, nimbler and more profitable.  It has consolidated facilities to reduce costs and improved service quality by investing in things like temperature sensors as well as package scanning and tracking. It also has focused on high-growth and high-margin segments like healthcare, returns and, most recently, data centers.   UPS has made significant headway in specialized healthcare logistics, shipping temperature-controlled chemotherapy drugs, cancer treatments and direct-to-consumer GLP-1 weight-loss drugs. It is now the largest player in the $148 billion global healthcare market after some key acquisitions and internal growth.    That business generated revenue of $6 billion for UPS in 2020 and is forecast to reach $13 billion in revenue this year, Tome said.   UPS is racing rival FedEx for the same high-margin volume as they each wean off low-margin to unprofitable deliveries of online purchases and other goods. FedEx, which has set up a dedicated team to court data center-related business, will report quarterly results after the market close on Wednesday. Meanwhile, retailers like Amazon.com  and Walmart as well as growing rivals like OnTrac are aggressively targeting domestic shipments in certain parts of the country. Some of that includes volume UPS and FedEx don't want.  UPS has cut doorstep deliveries of millions of packages for Amazon that it considered unprofitable, which helped lift its margin. Tome said the margin would keep improving every year. "We've moved through an important inflection point," Tome said.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Lazio crush Sassuolo to go top, Roma and Como win late
item.description: Lazio maintained their unbeaten start to the season and moved provisionally top of the Serie A standings with a 6-2 win at Sassuolo on Tuesday, while AS Roma kept pace with a 4-2 victory over Cagliari and Como won 3-1 at Torino.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Lazio maintained their unbeaten start to the season and moved provisionally top of the Serie A standings with a 6-2 win at Sassuolo on Tuesday, while AS Roma kept pace with a 4-2 victory over Cagliari and Como won 3-1 at Torino. Gennaro Gattuso's Lazio side have eight wins from nine games and are on 25 points, three ahead of Inter Milan, who visit bottom club Venezia on Wednesday. Roma are one point further back in third, one point ahead of Como. Lazio, backed by a sizeable away support, roared into a second-minute lead through Kenneth Taylor but the game had barely restarted following a lengthy VAR check when Sassuolo equalised through a Josip Sutalo own-goal. Lazio looked in control with quick goals from Gustav Isaksen and Romano Floriani Mussolini before Sassuolo's hopes of a comeback took a hammering just after the half-hour mark when Kristian Thorstvedt was shown a red card for a foul on Mattia Zaccagni. Sassuolo did, however, pull a goal back two minutes from halftime through Sebastiano Esposito only to see Lazio restore their two-goal advantage in added time before the break when Zaccagni was allowed a free header from Isaksen's cross. Zaccagni spurned a chance to score again shortly after the interval when Simone Cinquegrano's handball gave Lazio a penalty, but the captain's tame spot kick was saved by Stefano Turati. Lazio found a fifth goal with Tijjani Noslin's curled shot from outside the box before a foul by Duje Caleta-Car on Isaksen gave the visitors another penalty, and this time Turati saved from Davide Frattesi. Noslin again made up for Lazio's wastefulness from the spot with another strike from distance to complete the scoring as Gattuso's side continue to look like real title contenders. "We don't have to look at the standings because both I and many of them are not used to it and therefore we have to do things seriously and at a thousand miles per hour," Gattuso said. ROMA AND COMO EARN LATE WINS The Stadio Olimpico was temporarily silenced when Cagliari took the lead in the 10th minute from the penalty spot, with M'Bala Nzola converting after a handball by Niccolo Pisilli. Roma drew level five minutes later with Emanuele Lulli's header from a pinpoint cross by Nahuel Molina and the hosts went ahead in the 21st minute when Lulli turned provider, his cross volleyed to the net by Pisilli. Keeper Pierluigi Gollini was called into action on several occasions in the second half and kept Roma in front until Daniel Maldini netted Cagliari's equaliser nine minutes from time. Roma looked set to slip further behind the leaders until Rodrigo Mora and Donyell Malen both scored in the final five minutes. Che Adams put Torino ahead in the 24th minute, and the hosts were on course to win their fourth successive game until three goals in the last 10 minutes from Jacobo Ramon, Nico Paz and Martin Baturina earned Como an unlikely victory.

item.title: 米連邦選挙委サイトにハッカー攻撃、中間選挙控え資金開示に支障
item.description:
Dawn Kopecki
[ニューヨーク ２７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Dawn Kopecki

[ニューヨーク　２７日　ロイター] - 米連邦選挙委員会（ＦＥＣ）のウェブサイトがハッカーによる攻撃を受け、１１月３日の中間選挙を１週間後に控える中、同委員会の電子申告システムが停止していることが、ロイターが確認した電子メールで分かった。

ＦＥＣは声明で「現時点でＦＥＣの電子申告システムは停止しており、ＩＴ担当者が復旧に向けて対応している」と説明。利用者が過去の報告書をウェブサイトで閲覧することはできるとしたが、システム障害についてこれ以上のコメントは控えた。

ＦＥＣは候補者や政治活動委員会（ＰＡＣ）の資金支出の報告と開示を監督。選挙運営そのものには関与していないため、今回の障害で有権者の投票に影響は及ばないとみられる。

ＦＥＣが公表したシステム状況によると、電子申告システムは米東部時間２６日午後１０時（日本時間２７日午前１１時）ごろから停止。政治団体などが提出する選挙資金の２４時間、４８時間支出報告書の電子申告ができなくなっている。

この件について、米サイバーセキュリティー・インフラ安全保障庁（ＣＩＳＡ）と米連邦捜査局（ＦＢＩ）からコメントは得られていない。

ＦＥＣの電子申告担当者は２６日夜、選挙関連の法令順守を支援する複数の企業に送ったメールで「悪意ある者がＦＥＣのシステムへの侵入を試みている。このため、外部向けのウェブサービスを一時的に停止せざるを得なくなった」とした。

申告システムが復旧するまで、有権者は資金支出の実態を把握できない状態に置かれる。無党派の選挙資金監視団体オープンシークレッツの調査責任者ブレンダン・グラビン氏は今回の障害について「重大な問題だ」と指摘。

「これらは何が起きているかを知るための重要な報告書だ」とし、選挙最終盤で誰がどこに資金を投じているかを追跡できる唯一の手段だと述べた。

item.title: Parents of Alex Pretti slam Trump administration for withholding evidence into his killing
item.description: The parents of Alex Pretti, a US citizen shot and killed by federal immigration agents in Minnesota in January, criticized President Donald Trump's administration on Tuesday for withholding evidence from local prosecutors who are investigating the incident.
item.dc:creator: Julia Harte
item.content:encoded: The parents of Alex Pretti, a US citizen [USN:S0N3WW007 TEXT:"shot and killed by federal immigration agents"] in Minnesota in January, criticized President Donald Trump's administration on Tuesday for withholding evidence from local prosecutors who are investigating the incident. "Our experience with the Department of Justice has left us wondering how Alex will ever get justice," Pretti's father Michael said at a press conference in Minneapolis, the first time the family has spoken publicly since his death. "Do your job and stop shielding Alex's killers," he demanded. The Justice Department said in a statement to Reuters that "communications with family members, if any, come at a later stage of a case, such as indictment, initial appearance, plea, trial, or sentencing. Those communications do not typically occur during an investigation." Pretti, 37, an intensive-care-unit nurse, was killed while participating in protests against the federal immigration enforcement surge in Minneapolis, shortly after ICE agents fatally shot another US citizen, Renee Good. Their deaths sparked fierce protests, condemnations from local leaders and calls for accountability. FIGHT OVER EVIDENCE Trump officials swiftly [USN:L1N3YQ04Q TEXT:"defended the Border Patrol agents"] who killed Pretti, claiming he was trying to attack them with a handgun he was carrying legally. But [USN:S0N3WW007 TEXT:"bystander videos showed"] Pretti had a phone in his hand and was trying to help a protester who had been pushed to the ground when agents pinned him down and shot him. Hennepin County Attorney Mary Moriarty launched a criminal investigation soon after Pretti’s death. In March, she [USN:L6N40C16O TEXT:"sued the Trump administration"] for access to evidence in the killings of Pretti and Good, as well as the non-lethal shooting of a Venezuelan man by an immigration agent in January. Moriarty [USN:L1N43F0OM TEXT:"said in July"] that the federal government was handing over "voluminous" evidence related to the shootings. When her office examined the material from the Minnesota US Attorney's Office, however, it realized "some information had been withheld," Moriarty said earlier this month in a declaration filed in federal district court in Washington. "Furthermore, it is clear that the federal government has obtained additional material since they last shared information with the State," including material obtained through grand jury processes and other witness statements, Moriarty said in the filing. US prosecutors responded that they were not obligated to release further evidence because Moriarty's office had not yet initiated legal proceedings in the case. "The timing is consistent with how these types of investigations proceed," the DOJ said in its statement. "It has been a miserable year for our family," Pretti's mother Susan said at Tuesday's press conference. "All we want is justice for Alex [and] that the federal government treat us with the dignity and respect that our son deserves."

item.title: Giants won't alter trade deadline strategy with RB Tyrone Tracy Jr. on IR
item.description: The New York Giants placed running back Tyrone Tracy Jr. on injured reserve Tuesday with a hamstring injury.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The New York Giants placed running back Tyrone Tracy Jr. on injured reserve Tuesday with a hamstring injury. Tracy sustained the injury during the second quarter of New York's 27-21 overtime victory over the Houston Texans on Sunday. The move will sideline Tracy for at least four games for the Giants (4-2-1), who will return from their bye week to visit the reeling Philadelphia Eagles on Nov. 8. Schoen said the injury is not considered season-ending, but the Giants did sign former Memphis running back Greg Desrosiers off the Los Angeles Chargers' practice squad. Tracy, 26, has rushed 19 times for 55 yards and two touchdowns this season. He has rushed for 1,634 yards and nine touchdowns in 39 career games (23 starts) with New York since being drafted in the fifth round in 2024. With Tracy sidelined, Devin Singletary likely will receive a few more carries as he backs up Cam Skattebo in the backfield. The Giants also have Phil Mafah on their practice squad, so Schoen said Tracy's injury does not change the team's approach to the trade deadline. Without fourth- or fifth-round picks in next year's draft, Schoen said that could factor into players the team might be interested in at various positions ahead of the trade deadline. "It's easy to say, 'go sign X, Y, and Z position,' but if a team's really not ready to get rid of somebody where they're asking too much, it doesn't match up with where you see the value, then it doesn't make sense to do it," Schoen said. "We're going to look at all the options that are available. And there's certain teams that have already started some trades and we've been in contact with those teams and have a pretty good idea of who may or may not be available. And again, it's got to make sense, short-term and long-term, when you make those moves." The Giants parted with next year's fourth-round selection as part of a package of picks sent to Cleveland to move up to draft wide receiver Malachi Fields. The fifth-rounder was sent to Minnesota to acquire quarterback J.J. McCarthy. "The utilization of those draft picks that we gave up to get those two players, we're happy we have them," Schoen said. "There are always options to regain capital down the road. "If it makes sense right now for us to do something in the short-term and long-term, we're going to look at any opportunity that we can to upgrade the roster. And, again, there's avenues that we can try to recoup draft picks down the road." --Field Level Media

item.title: ヨルダン、シリアで「イスラム国」戦闘員20人超殺害と表明 教会襲撃に報復
item.description: [２７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２７日　ロイター] - ヨルダン政府は２７日、シリア南部で前日夜に実施した軍事作戦で過激派組織「イスラム国」（ＩＳ）の戦闘員２０人以上を殺害したと発表した。軍事作戦は先週ヨルダンで起きた教会襲撃事件を受けたもので、ヨルダン当局が実行犯が国境を越えて活動する武装勢力とつながりがあるとの見方を示す中、米国の同盟国同士であるヨルダンとシリアの間で緊張が高まっている。

シリアによると、今回の軍事作戦で子ども３人と女性１人を含む７人が死亡した。ヨルダン政府報道官は民間人の犠牲が出たことに遺憾の意を示している。

シリア外務省は、今回の軍事作戦はシリアの主権を侵害するものと非難。同時に、シリア政府はヨルダン政府と連携しているとし、国境警備の強化と同様の事件の再発防止に向け、両国で合同の治安委員会を設置すると明らかにした。

ヨルダンでは２３日、首都アンマンの南西約１２０キロにあるカラク県ハムード村のギリシャ正教会で葬儀が執り行われていた際に襲撃を受け、少なくとも９人が死亡したほか、４０人が負傷した。これを受けヨルダン政府は２６日、襲撃事件の実行犯はシリア南部を拠点とする「テロ組織」と関係していると判断し、同地域にある武装勢力の隠れ家を空軍が攻撃したと発表していた。

ヨルダンは長年にわたり過激主義との戦いで米国の有力な協力国だった。西側諸国との関係改善を目指すシリア現政権も過激主義の抑制に取り組む姿勢を示している。

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（27日） 3:56 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

まちまちで取引を終えた。英政府の予算案発表を２８日に控え、投資家には様子見姿勢も目立った。ＦＴＳＥ１００種は反落。一方、中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．８８％高と続伸した。

金融大手ＨＳＢＣは５．４％安。資産運用事業の伸び鈍化などで、２０２６年７─９月期の収益が市場予想を下回り、売られた。ナットウエストは１．５％、ロイズは０．３％それぞれ下落。一方、バークレイズは０．８％上昇した。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種生活必需品株指数は１．２６％安。通期予想への懸念から日用品のレキット・ベンキーザーは４．９％下落した。

イベント主催会社のインフォーマは２．４％高。スタイフェルが目標株価を引き上げたテクノロジー・サービスプロバイダーのコンピュータセンターは１．２％上昇した。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞

続伸して取引を終えた。企業決算での堅調な業績や、原油先物価格の上昇一服が好材料視された。下落が目立っていたフランスのＣＡＣ４０指数は０．５１％高だった。

米アンソロピックの新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）申請の動きを受け、ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種テクノロジー株指数は１．９９％高。オランダの半導体組立装置メーカー、ＢＥセミコンダクターは１１．４％高。米半導体製造装置大手アプライド・マテリアルズによる出資の引き上げを受け、買われた。

直近決算の売上高が市場予想を上回ったスイスの容器メーカー、ＳＩＧグループは９．６％上昇した。

資源株指数は２．０８％高。

通期業績見通しを引き上げたスイスの製薬大手ノバルティスは１．０％上昇。

一方、金融大手ＨＳＢＣは５．４％安。２０２６年７─９月期決算の収入が市場予想を下回り、売られた。

フランスの１０月の消費者信頼感指数は１３年６月以来の低水準となった。市場では、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が２９日に開く金融政策決定会合で、政策金利を据え置くとの観測が根強い。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞

域内国債利回りが総じて低下し、フランス国債利回りは落ち着いた動きとなった。中東和平協議が進展する可能性に市場の関心が再び向かい、原油価格が下落したことが背景。

フランス１０年国債利回りは、終盤で４．９１％と横ばい。２３日に格付け会社ムーディーズによる格下げを回避したことを受け、２６日には約１１ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下し、１日の低下幅として５カ月ぶりの大きさとなった。この動きを受けて利益確定売りが出たため、２７日序盤には利回りが上昇していた。

コロンビア・スレッドニードのシニアエコノミスト、アンソニー・ウィリス氏は「政治的な決着や予算合意が直ちに実現する見込みはほとんどない。議会審議は今後数週間続く見通しで、フランスの財政政策は引き続き市場の緊張要因となりそうだ」と述べた。

安全資産であり、ユーロ圏国債市場全体の指標となるドイツ１０年国債利回りは１．１ｂｐ低下の３．３４％。同２年国債利回りは４．３ｂｐ低下の３．０３６％となった。

ベルギー国債も同国の重い債務負担を背景に、このところ売り圧力にさらされている。ベルギー１０年国債利回りは２７日、１ｂｐ強上昇して４．４％となった。ただ、上昇幅はフランス国債よりはるかに小さい。

item.description: NEW YORK, Oct 27 : The US Federal Election Commission's website has been targeted by a hacker or hackers, according to an email seen by Reuters, disrupting the agency's electronic filings system a week before the November 3 elections.The cyberattack comes as so-called super PACs and dark money groups spend re
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

Exclusive-Hackers target US FEC system, disrupting campaign finance disclosures days before midterms

The offices of the Federal Election Commission are seen in Washington, D.C., U.S., May 11, 2021. REUTERS/Andrew Kelly

A 3D printed model of men working on computers are seen in front of displayed binary code and words "Hacker" in this illustration taken, July 5, 2021. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

28 Oct 2026 02:44AM (Updated: 28 Oct 2026 07:17AM)

FAST

NEW YORK, Oct 27 : The US Federal Election Commission's website has been targeted by a hacker or hackers, according to an email seen by Reuters, disrupting the agency's electronic filings system a week before the November 3 elections. The cyberattack comes as so-called super PACs and dark money groups spend record sums in the final days of the races. The elections will determine whether President Donald Trump's Republicans maintain their majorities in Congress for the next two years.  In a statement, the FEC said, "at this time, the FEC’s electronic filing system is currently offline and our IT staff are actively working to restore service." The FEC, which tracks the spending of candidates and political committees, said users could still search the website for past reports. It declined further comment on the outage. The FEC does not play a role in administering US elections and the outage should have no effect on voters' ability to cast ballots.

The outage prevents organizations from filing the FEC's 24-hour and 48-hour spending reports, which show how much political groups and others are spending on specific races. "I've never seen this in 26 years," said Steven Mele, president and CEO at political finance compliance firm MBA Consulting Group. "The result is there will be less disclosure on the elections" until it's fixed.  A status message posted by the FEC said its filing system had been down since around 10 p.m. ET on Monday (0200 GMT Tuesday). The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency referred questions to the FEC. The FBI did not immediately return messages seeking comment. The FEC posted the notice after campaign finance officers couldn't file mandatory reports late on Monday.  "We have a bad actor attempting to breach FEC systems. As a result, we’ve had to temporarily shut down our web facing services," an FEC electronic filings officer said in the email to several campaign compliance firms that night.  The midterms are now the most expensive US election in history with roughly $11.21 billion spent on advertising and future reservations so far, according to political ad tracker AdImpact. It's surpassed the previous record set in the 2024 elections when $11.2 billion was spent on all races, including $3.2 billion on the presidential race between Trump and former Vice President Kamala Harris, AdImpact said.  Much of the spending is being driven by super PACs, which can accept unlimited amounts of money from wealthy individuals and corporations and spend as much as they want on campaigns with few restrictions.  The sums being spent in recent weeks are staggering as Democrats gain ground in several Republican strongholds. Super PACs and dark money groups have spent an average of over $50 million per day over the last week, said Brendan Glavin, research director at nonpartisan campaign watchdog group OpenSecrets. More than $250 million in spending was reported on October 20 alone, he added.  "It's a big deal," he said of the outage, which leaves voters in the dark until the filing system is back online.  "These are the key reports that tell us what is happening," Glavin said. "In the last days of the election this is the only way for us to keep track of where the money's being spent" and who's spending it.

Source: Reuters

item.title: トランプ氏、ＡＩの呼称は「不正確」 近く公式禁止する考え表明
item.description: [ワシントン ２７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン ２７日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は、文書などで「人工知能（ＡＩ）」という用語の使用を禁止する考えを示した。自身が好む「超知能（スーパーインテリジェンス、ＳＩ）」を米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）が使わないのはなぜかと疑問を呈した。

トランプ氏は自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」への投稿で、「ＷＳＪはいつになったら、非常に悪く不正確な『ＡＩ』の呼称を、事実上誰もが使用している、あるいは間もなく使用するようになる『ＳＩ』と呼ぶようになるのか」と述べた。

その上で「われわれは近く、その不正確さを理由に、『ＡＩ』という用語を全ての関連文書やその他あらゆる場面において公式に禁止する」と述べた。

item.title: ＥＵ・アジアの市場アクセス拡大呼びかけ、独首相 アジア歴訪スタート
item.description:
Andreas Rinke
[シンガポール ２７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Andreas Rinke

[シンガポール ２７日 ロイター] - ドイツのメルツ首相は２７日、アジア歴訪の最初の訪問国となったシンガポールのシンクタンクで講演し、欧州とアジアとの間で市場アクセスを拡大し、貿易や技術、安全保障面で協力関係を強めることを呼びかけた。

メルツ氏は、世界秩序の崩壊により共通の利益が脅かされているとして「われわれは地政学上の新たな時代の入り口にいる」と主張。「自由や主権、安全、繁栄が危機にさらされている」として、緊密な協力の必要性を訴えた。具体的には、日本や英国、カナダ、シンガポールなど１２カ国が加盟する包括的・先進的環太平洋経済連携協定（ＣＰＴＰＰ）の加盟国と欧州連合（ＥＵ）の２つの大きな枠組みの連携を提唱した。これらを合わせると「世界貿易の３分の１以上を占める」と指摘。欧州とアジアの関係強化は「長期的かつ戦略的」なものだとし、「新時代に対する最も重要な対応の一つ」だと言及した。

メルツ氏は、中国との完全な経済面でのデカップリング（切り離し）に関しては「誤り」であり、「安全も繁栄ももたらさない」との見解を示した。切り離しではなく、サプライチェーン（供給網）や技術、資源などで「不健全で一方的な依存」を減らす必要があると主張。同時に、貿易面での競争が「過剰生産能力や市場アクセスへの制限で歪められている場合には、是正が必要だ」と述べた。

メルツ氏は今回のアジア歴訪で、日本や韓国なども訪問する予定だ。

item.title: US agency approves Amazon Leo’s $11.5 billion acquisition of Globalstar
item.description: The Federal Communications Commission said on Tuesday it approved Amazon Leo’s $11.5 billion deal to acquire Globalstar as the retail giant's satellite arm seeks to build a communications network to compete with SpaceX's Starlink .
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: The Federal Communications Commission said on Tuesday it approved Amazon (AMZN.O) Leo’s $11.5 billion deal to acquire Globalstar (GSAT.O) as the retail giant's satellite arm seeks to build a communications network to compete with SpaceX's Starlink (SPCX.O) . Amazon Leo has launched nearly 400 satellites since April 2025 and aims to deploy thousands of satellites in Earth's low orbit by 2029. Through the deal, Amazon adds Globalstar's two dozen satellites and its mobile-satellite spectrum. Amazon, which has committed to investing more than $10 billion in Leo, is preparing to roll out its commercial satellite services by the end of 2026, the FCC said. The FCC said the companies’ assets will boost Amazon Leo’s entry into the direct-to-device market and allow the satellite operator to offer fixed and mobile services. "The FCC has empowered Amazon Leo to deliver fast, next-gen satellite broadband services, increase competition, and help communities stay connected all across the country," FCC Chair Brendan Carr said. Tech companies are pouring billions of dollars into capturing the lucrative market for satellite-based connectivity as they race to compete with Starlink's network of more than 11,000 satellites. Amazon praised the approval, saying it "brings us a step closer to bringing new connectivity capabilities to customers." Amazon in July sought [USN:L4N43T10V TEXT:"approval from the FCC for up to 5,105"] satellites. Direct-to-device satellite technology allows smartphones and other devices to connect directly to satellites. The FCC will vote on Thursday to advance a new auction of wireless spectrum to boost "direct-to-device" services. Globalstar currently powers satellite-based safety features such as Emergency SOS and Find My for Apple's (AAPL.O) iPhone and Apple Watch users. Amazon said earlier that it has signed an agreement with Apple to continue providing those services. Apple invested about $1.5 billion in Globalstar in 2024 to fund the expansion of its iPhone communication services, in a deal that also gave the tech giant a 20% equity stake in Globalstar. Apple accounted for about 63% of Globalstar's revenue last year and Amazon plans to acquire Apple's stake, the FCC said. Globalstar said late last year that a new, Apple-backed network under development would expand its footprint to 54 satellites, including a small number of backups, from the two dozen currently.

item.title: Mexico's electoral body pledges internal overhaul after corruption crisis
item.description: Mexico's National Electoral Institute (INE) promised on Tuesday to carry out an exhaustive, independent and transparent overhaul to guarantee its continuity, after its chief resigned over allegations of irregularities and corruption.
item.dc:creator: Raul Cortes
item.content:encoded: Mexico's National Electoral Institute (INE) promised on Tuesday to carry out an exhaustive, independent and transparent overhaul to guarantee its continuity, after its chief resigned over allegations of irregularities and corruption. The leadership [USN:L2N46C0L2 TEXT:"upheaval"] raises fresh questions over the credibility and stability of the autonomous authority as it prepares to oversee Mexico's 2027 midterm elections. Lawmakers face the task of choosing a permanent successor to Guadalupe Taddei to steer the INE through an increasingly contentious political environment. "It is a good time for whoever takes office to exercise transparency and ensure that no department within the National Electoral Institute favors any particular side, and that the Institute fulfills its duties," Mexico's President Claudia Sheinbaum said at her daily press conference. INE's top members announced several measures to overcome the crisis at an unusual press conference led by Blanca Cruz, who earlier was named as interim president. Her designation is due to be formalized later on Tuesday. Cruz, an electoral adviser, joined the INE's General Council in April. "The provisional presidency has a clear responsibility: to facilitate dialogue, ensure institutional continuity, and contribute to the decisions that are being shaped through deliberation and consensus," Cruz said at the press conference. Taddei [USN:L2N46C0L2 TEXT:"resigned"] on Monday in the most high-profile departure tied to alleged corruption in Sheinbaum's two-year-old presidency. Sheinbaum said she supported Taddei's decision. Mexico's Superior Audit Office is investigating alleged irregularities involving INE contracts, including possible conflicts of interest and the triangulation of public funds. Taddei, in local news outlets, has been accused of favoring an INE contractor, with whom she has a personal relationship, with contracts worth millions of dollars. Cruz said the INE council was reviewing officials in decision-making roles, adding that three senior officials had already resigned: the heads of IT Services and the Gender Equality and Non-Discrimination Unit, and the official responsible for material resources. Local media described all three as members of Taddei’s inner circle. Taddei has not spoken publicly since resigning. "Over the past few days, rumors, fabricated material, leaks, and versions of events have spread through the media and social networks, and as in all such cases, their authenticity, context, and purpose must be verified and corroborated," she said in a statement on Sunday announcing her planned resignation.

item.title: 米、ブラジル出国のボルソナロ氏に入国ビザ発給へ＝国務省高官
item.description:
Ricardo Brito Gram Slattery
[サンパウロ ２７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Ricardo Brito　Gram Slattery

[サンパウロ ２７日 ロイター] - ブラジル大統領選で現職のルラ大統領に敗れたフラビオ・ボルソナロ上院議員が、連邦最高裁判所のパスポート提出命令に従わずに米国に向けて出国したことが２７日、関係筋３人の話で分かった。米国務省は同氏と家族に入国ビザを発給する方針だ。

ブラジル連邦警察の高官は、フラビオ氏が通常の出入国審査手続きを経て国外に出た記録は確認されていないとしている。

フラビオ氏と妻、娘２人の居場所は直ちには明らかになっていない。ボルソナロ家に近い関係筋の１人は、フラビオ氏が米フロリダ州に到着したと述べたものの、具体的な場所については明らかにしなかった。

米国務省の高官は「国務省はフラビオ・ボルソナロ氏と家族にビザを発給し、米国への入国を認める」と述べた。

フラビオ氏の出国は、米国とブラジルの亀裂を深める恐れがある。ルラ氏はこれまでに、米政府がボルソナロ一族と結託して同一族の政権復帰を図っていると非難しており、ロイターは２５日の選挙に先立ち、同一族の政権復帰に向けた米国務省の取り組みについて報じていた。

トランプ米大統領はかつて、フラビオ氏の父親であるジャイル・ボルソナロ前大統領が、ブラジルで司法による迫害の犠牲になったと主張していた。

フラビオ氏は大統領選の第１回投票では首位に立っていたが、２５日に行われた決選投票でルラ氏に敗北。フラビオ氏は２６日、収監されているジャイル氏と面会した後、連邦警察からパスポートの提出を求められたと明らかにしていた。

関係筋によると、フラビオ氏は資金洗浄（マネーロンダリング）捜査の一環として２６日に２４時間以内のパスポート提出を命じられていた。別の関係筋２人によると、この期限が過ぎたことを受け、同氏のパスポートは失効扱いになっているという。フラビオ氏は不正行為を否定している。

フラビオ氏は２月に上院議員の任期が終了すると、訴追免責特権を失う。同氏は２６日、逃亡する考えはないと述べていた。

フラビオ氏の父親のジャイル氏は２０２２年の大統領選でルラ氏への敗北を認めることを拒否した後、米国に渡航。ジャイル氏はその後ブラジルに帰国したが、クーデターを企てた罪で禁錮２７年の判決を受けた。

米国在住のフラビオ氏の弟、エドゥアルド・ボルソナロ氏は大統領選の決選投票前、ポッドキャスターのスティーブン・クラウダー氏に対し「兄が勝てなければ、国外へ出るべきだと考えている」と述べ、フラビオ氏が選挙に敗れた場合には国外移住が必要になるとの認識を示していた。
